With reach_repair on (the default) the first blind check ends the checking and the Judge's own repair takes over (see _reach_repair). argv:
import os, subprocess
for name in ('bench',):
    d = os.path.realpath(os.path.expanduser('~/rm/' + name))
    def g(*a):
        x = subprocess.run(['git', '-C', d] + list(a), capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=60)
        return x.stdout.strip() if x.returncode == 0 else 'ERR:' + (x.stderr.strip().splitlines() or ['?'])[-1][:120]
    if not os.path.isdir(os.path.join(d, '.git')):
        print(name, d, 'NO_CLONE')
        continue
    head, om = g('rev-parse', 'HEAD'), g('rev-parse', 'refs/remotes/origin/main')
    rn = g('ls-remote', 'origin', 'refs/heads/main').split()
    rn = rn[0] if rn and not rn[0].startswith('ERR') else 'UNREAD'
    known = rn != 'UNREAD' and g('cat-file', '-t', rn) == 'commit'
    lr = g('rev-list', '--left-right', '--count', 'HEAD...refs/remotes/origin/main').split()
    anc = subprocess.run(['git', '-C', d, 'merge-base', '--is-ancestor', 'HEAD', 'refs/remotes/origin/main'], capture_output=True, timeout=60).returncode == 0
    dirty = [l for l in g('status', '--porcelain', '--untracked-files=all', '--', '.', ':(exclude)conversations').splitlines() if l.strip()]
    print(name, d, 'HEAD=%s origin_main_ref=%s github_main_now=%s github_main_fetched=%s ahead=%s behind=%s head_in_origin_main=%s branch=%s dirty=%d' % (
        head, om, rn, known, lr[0] if len(lr) == 2 else '?', lr[1] if len(lr) == 2 else '?', anc, g('rev-parse', '--abbrev-ref', 'HEAD'), len(dirty)))
    for l in dirty[:60]:
        print('  ' + l)
    if len(dirty) > 60:
        print('  ... %d more' % (len(dirty) - 60))

relentless_store_journal.what: the Relentless store journal the box masks, read now on this machine (CHECKER_REACH_FIX_STORE_STILL_DARK gen 3: KUQY's Judge needed the journal's jam rows, which relentless_store_attempts does not carry): the jam alarms of journal.jsonl in the candidate's own registry window, read from {repo}'s src/RimMandrake/rimflow/jam_classes.json at {sha} as data only (kinds and window_days; no candidate code runs). One header line 'journal <path> read_at= window_days= kinds= jam_rows=N by_kind=<kind>:<n>,... shown=N', then each row, deduped by (at, reason) and with the breaker's 'open until' prefix off as jam_classes.reason does, as one JSON journal line {at, do: alarm, kind, why} the Judge can feed to `jam_classes.py census --journal`, newest kept to a 16000-byte budget. Only the supervisor's own alarm text crosses: no other kind, no item id, act, attempt, learned.md, receipt or run output. NO_JOURNAL / NO_REGISTRY say the reading could not be made, never a clean zero.
argv:
import calendar, json, os, re, sys, time
s = os.path.realpath(os.path.expanduser('~/rm/relentless/store'))
j = os.path.join(s, 'journal.jsonl')
now = time.time()
ts = time.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', time.gmtime(now))
slug = re.compile(r'^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,39}$')
iso = re.compile(r'^\d{4}-\d\d-\d\dT\d\d:\d\d:\d\d(\.\d+)?Z$')
pre = re.compile(r'^breaker open until \S+: ')
try:
    with open(os.path.join(sys.argv[1], 'src', 'RimMandrake', 'rimflow', 'jam_classes.json'), encoding='utf-8') as f:
        reg = json.load(f)
    kinds = sorted(set(k for k in reg.get('kinds') or [] if isinstance(k, str) and slug.match(k)))
    days = reg.get('window_days')
    days = days if isinstance(days, (int, float)) and not isinstance(days, bool) and 0 < days <= 60 else 14
except (OSError, ValueError, AttributeError, TypeError, IndexError) as x:
    print('journal %s read_at=%s NO_REGISTRY %s' % (j, ts, str(x)[:120]))
    raise SystemExit(0)
since = now - days * 86400
rows, keys, by = [], set(), {}
try:
    f = open(j, encoding='utf-8', errors='replace')
except OSError as x:
    print('journal %s read_at=%s NO_JOURNAL %s' % (j, ts, str(x)[:120]))
    raise SystemExit(0)
with f:
    for ln in f:
        if '"alarm"' not in ln:
            continue
        try:
            d = json.loads(ln)
        except ValueError:
            continue
        if not isinstance(d, dict) or d.get('do') != 'alarm' or d.get('kind') not in kinds:
            continue
        at = d.get('at')
        if not isinstance(at, str) or not iso.match(at) or calendar.timegm(time.strptime(at[:19], '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S')) < since:
            continue
        why = pre.sub('', str(d.get('why') or '')).strip()[:400]
        if (at, why) in keys:
            continue
        keys.add((at, why))
        by[d['kind']] = by.get(d['kind'], 0) + 1
        rows.append({'at': at, 'do': 'alarm', 'kind': d['kind'], 'why': why})
keep, size = [], 0
for d in reversed(rows):
    size += len(json.dumps(d, sort_keys=True)) + 1
    if size > 16000:
        break
    keep.insert(0, d)
print('journal %s read_at=%s window_days=%s kinds=%s jam_rows=%d by_kind=%s shown=%d (newest last; each line a journal row '
      'jam_classes.py census --journal reads)' % (j, ts, days, ','.join(kinds), len(rows),
                                                  ','.join('%s:%d' % kv for kv in sorted(by.items())) or '-', len(keep)))
for d in keep:
    print(json.dumps(d, sort_keys=True))

jawabench_build_candidate._why: the code run is the candidate's own build.py and csproj at a sha already on origin/main: the same landed code the supervisor's books run, chosen by this fixed argv, never by worker text. ~10 s measured 2026-11-05 against offbox_max_s 120.
argv:
import os, shutil, subprocess, sys, tempfile
repo, sha = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
want = ['src/Directory.Build.props', 'src/Directory.Build.targets', 'src/RimMandrake/bridgetools', 'src/RimMandrake/Utils', 'src/RimMandrake/contracts']
ls = subprocess.run(['git', '-C', repo, 'ls-tree', '--name-only', sha, '--'] + want, capture_output=True, text=True)
paths = ls.stdout.split()
if ls.returncode or 'src/RimMandrake/bridgetools' not in paths:
    print('NOT BUILT: no companion sources at %s: %s' % (sha, (ls.stderr or '').strip()[-300:]))
    sys.exit(2)
work = tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='offbox-winbuild-')
stage = None
try:
    a = subprocess.run(['git', '-C', repo, 'archive', '--format=tar', sha, '--'] + paths, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    if a.returncode or subprocess.run(['tar', '-x', '-C', work], input=a.stdout).returncode:
        print('NOT BUILT: git archive %s failed: %s' % (sha, a.stderr.decode('utf-8', 'replace')[-300:]))
        sys.exit(2)
    sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(work, 'src', 'RimMandrake', 'Utils'))
    import winbuild
    stage = os.path.join(winbuild.BUILD_ROOT, 'offbox', 'jawabench-%s-%d' % (sha[:12], os.getpid()))
    os.makedirs(stage)
    print('candidate %s: %d source paths exported; staged build root %s; build.py --gm, plan only, never deployed' % (sha, len(paths), winbuild.win(stage)))
    b = subprocess.run([sys.executable, os.path.join(work, 'src', 'RimMandrake', 'bridgetools', 'build.py'), '--gm'], cwd=work, env=dict(os.environ, WINBUILD_ROOT=stage), stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, timeout=105)
    out = b.stdout.decode('utf-8', 'replace').splitlines()
    print('\n'.join(out[-120:]))
    print('build.py --gm exit=%d at %s' % (b.returncode, sha))
    sys.exit(b.returncode)
finally:
    shutil.rmtree(work, ignore_errors=True)
    if stage:
        shutil.rmtree(stage, ignore_errors=True)

import os, shutil, subprocess, sys, tempfile
repo, sha = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
tests = ['selftest_relentless_reach_git_grant', 'selftest_relentless_reach_item_prose']
want = ['src/RimMandrake/rimflow', 'src/RimMandrake/Utils']

    print('NOT RUN: no rimflow at %s: %s' % (sha, (ls.stderr or '').strip()[-300:]))
    sys.exit(2)
work = tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='.offbox-unitprobe-', dir=os.path.expanduser('~'))
try:
    a = subprocess.run(['git', '-C', repo, 'archive', '--format=tar', sha, '--'] + want, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    if a.returncode or subprocess.run(['tar', '-x', '-C', work], input=a.stdout).returncode:

        p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-B', f], cwd=work, env=env, stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, timeout=100)

        print('== %s exit=%d' % (t, p.returncode))
        print('\n'.join(r[:300] for r in rows[-80:]))
        worst = max(worst, p.returncode if p.returncode >= 0 else 128 - p.returncode)
    print('unit-probe selftests exit=%d at %s' % (worst, sha))
    sys.exit(worst)
